name: canAddEditor
label: can add users as editors of the visualization

name: entities
label: A list of entities to display in the dialog

name: isModified
label: Sets the modal to modified, allowing the user to click confirm

name: managedEntities
label: puts the modal into managed mode, it will not longer update the list of entities itself

name: additionalOptions
label: A list of additional options to display when adding a new user

name: loading
label: Puts the modal into loading state to indicate you are fetching more data

name: footerActions
label: You can add custom footer actions to the modal in order to add custom functionality like copying the URL of the thing you are trying to share. We currently only support 2 buttons
